stories.headline: AMD and Anthropic sign multi-year deal: up to 2GW of MI450 GPUs plus $5B AMD investment

key_facts.fact: AMD and Anthropic announced a strategic partnership to deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs in AMD Helios rack-scale solutions, with deployment of the first gigawatt beginning in the first half of 2027.
key_facts.excerpt: AMD and Anthropic today announced a strategic partnership to deploy up to 2 gigawatts of AMD Instinct MI450 Series GPUs in AMD Helios rack-scale solutions, with deployment of the first gigawatt beginning in the first half of 2027.

key_facts.fact: AMD committed to make a strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic as part of the agreement.
key_facts.excerpt: AMD has committed to make a strategic equity investment of up to $5 billion in Anthropic.

key_facts.fact: Anthropic will deploy AMD Helios racks featuring Instinct MI455X GPUs together with AMD EPYC 'Venice' CPUs, Pensando networking and ROCm software, building on its existing use of AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic will deploy AMD Helios rack-scale solutions featuring AMD Instinct MI455X GPUs... together with AMD EPYC 'Venice' CPUs, AMD Pensando networking and ROCm software... This deployment builds on Anthropic's existing use of AMD Instinct MI355X GPUs.

key_facts.fact: The companies will collaborate to use Claude to optimize workloads for AMD Instinct GPUs and accelerate AMD ROCm development, and AMD will broadly adopt Claude across its engineering and product-development teams.
key_facts.excerpt: The companies will collaborate to use Claude to optimize workloads for AMD Instinct GPUs and accelerate AMD ROCm development, and AMD will broadly adopt Claude across its engineering and product development teams.

key_facts.fact: AMD's equity investment is contingent on the achievement of specific deployment targets, and Anthropic will use some of the chips in its own data centers while leasing additional capacity from cloud providers.
key_facts.excerpt: AMD will invest up to $5 billion in Anthropic, contingent on the achievement of specific deployment targets. The collaboration will see Anthropic utilizing some of these AMD chips for its data centers, while also leasing additional capacity from major cloud providers.

stories.headline: Super Micro books over $60B in Q4 orders, doubles gross-margin outlook to 15-17%

key_facts.fact: Super Micro's backlog rose to record levels at the end of fiscal 2026, with total new orders in excess of $60 billion received during the fourth quarter, expected to be delivered over future quarters.
key_facts.excerpt: Backlog rose to record levels at the end of fiscal 2026 with total new orders in excess of $60 billion received during the fourth quarter of fiscal 2026. These new orders are expected to be delivered over future quarters.

key_facts.fact: The company now estimates GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins of 15% to 17% for the quarter ended June 30, well above its earlier guidance of 8.2% to 8.4%, primarily due to a favorable customer and product mix.
key_facts.excerpt: GAAP and non-GAAP gross margins are estimated to be in the range of 15% to 17% which is significantly higher than our guidance of 8.2% to 8.4%, primarily due to a favorable customer and product mix.

key_facts.fact: Fourth-quarter revenue is estimated to be near the low end of the company's $11.0 billion to $12.5 billion guidance range.
key_facts.excerpt: Revenues for the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2026 are estimated to be near the low end of our guidance of $11.0 billion to $12.5 billion.

key_facts.fact: Super Micro shares surged about 17.5% in extended trading following the preliminary update on July 21.
key_facts.excerpt: Super Micro Computer said on Tuesday it had secured more than $60 billion in new orders in the fourth quarter, and now expects gross margin to exceed its previous forecast, sending its shares surging 17.5 per cent in extended trading.

key_facts.fact: The AI server maker said in June it would raise $7 billion through equity and equity-linked financing to fulfill orders worth about $39 billion for advanced AI servers from more than 20 customers.
key_facts.excerpt: Super Micro had said in June it would raise $7 billion through a series of equity and equity-linked financing transactions and use the proceeds to fulfill orders worth about $39 billion for its advanced AI servers from more than 20 customers.

stories.headline: UK's Humanoid raises $152M Series A at $1.35B, becoming Europe's first pure-play humanoid unicorn

key_facts.fact: UK-based robotics company Humanoid announced a $152 million Series A financing at a $1.35 billion post-money valuation, bringing total funding raised to date to $270 million.
key_facts.excerpt: Humanoid, a UK-based AI and robotics company building industrial humanoid robots, today announced a $152 million Series A financing at a $1.35 billion post-money valuation. This funding brings the total amount raised to date to $270 million.

key_facts.fact: The round was led by Prime Movers Lab, with participation from Schaeffler, Bosch, Fubon Financial Holding Venture Capital and Aglaé Ventures.
key_facts.excerpt: The round was led by Prime Movers Lab... with participation from Schaeffler, Bosch, Fubon Financial Holding Venture Capital, and Aglaé Ventures.

key_facts.fact: The company says it is the largest ever Series A for a humanoid-first robotics company in Europe, positioning Humanoid as the leading humanoid-first robotics unicorn in the UK and continental Europe.
key_facts.excerpt: It is the largest ever Series A for humanoid-first robotics company in Europe positioning Humanoid as the leading humanoid-first robotics unicorn in the UK and continental Europe.

key_facts.fact: Humanoid was founded as SKL Robotics Ltd. in 2024 by Artem Sokolov, has over 250 engineers, and all its robots run on KinetIQ, its proprietary four-layer AI framework.
key_facts.excerpt: The company, which was founded as SKL Robotics Ltd. in 2024, is also developing a bipedal version of the robot... The robot runs on KinetIQ, an AI framework for end-to-end orchestration of humanoid robot fleets.

key_facts.fact: Humanoid plans to begin deploying beta robots at customer sites in the fourth quarter of 2026 across manufacturing, logistics, retail and other industrial sectors, and has signed a deal with Schaeffler to deploy thousands of robots, with Bosch as contract-manufacturing partner.
key_facts.excerpt: The company added that it plans to begin deploying beta robots at customer sites in the fourth quarter of this year... recently signed an agreement for humanoid robots with Schaeffler, involving the planned deployment of thousands of robots... Bosch said it would serve as Humanoid's contract-manufacturing partner.

stories.headline: Nvidia details Vera Rubin platform as CoreWeave clocks 10x tokens-per-watt over Blackwell

key_facts.fact: Nvidia said Vera Rubin NVL72 production is ramping up, with racks running at partners CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, supported by a supply chain spanning more than 350 factory sites in 30 countries.
key_facts.excerpt: Vera Rubin NVL72 production is ramping up with racks running at partners CoreWeave, Google Cloud, Microsoft Azure and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure. Spanning 350+ factory sites in 30 [countries], Vera Rubin has the largest, most mature rack-scale supply chain ever assembled.

key_facts.fact: CoreWeave became the first AI cloud to bring up and validate Vera Rubin NVL72 and, running a DeepSeek-R1 benchmark, saw a 10x improvement in tokens per second per megawatt compared with Grace Blackwell NVL72.
key_facts.excerpt: CoreWeave became the first AI cloud to bring up and validate Vera Rubin NVL72... CoreWeave ran a DeepSeek-R1 benchmark on Vera Rubin NVL72 and saw 10x improvement in tokens per second per megawatt compared with Grace Blackwell NVL72.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia disclosed new details of its Vera data-center CPU at SIGGRAPH 2026, claiming its Olympus core delivers about 2X performance versus today's x86 server processors.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA just shared additional details regarding its upcoming Vera data center server processors at SIGGRAPH 2026... The company states that Vera's Olympus core delivers '2X performance'... versus today's x86 server processors.

key_facts.fact: Nvidia said early Vera test chips shipped to OpenAI, Anthropic and SpaceX in June, with OpenAI planning a large deployment starting this quarter.
key_facts.excerpt: Early test chips shipped to OpenAI, Anthropic, and SpaceX in June; OpenAI plans large deployment starting this quarter.

key_facts.fact: The Rubin GPU is built on TSMC's 3nm (N3P) process with two reticle-limited dies and packs 336 billion transistors, a 62% increase over the Blackwell GB300, and uses HBM4 memory with 288 GB of capacity and 22 TB/s of bandwidth.
key_facts.excerpt: NVIDIA's Rubin chip is made on TSMC's 3nm (N3P) process node and features two reticle-limited dies... The chip packs a total of 336 billion transistors, a 62% increase over the Blackwell GB300 chip... Rubin makes use of HBM4... 288 GB of capacity... peak bandwidth of 22 TB/s.

stories.headline: Intel Foundry lands Fortinet as its first publicly named external customer

key_facts.fact: Cybersecurity firm Fortinet will use Intel's foundry services to produce its next-generation security chip, the SP6, the two companies announced on July 21.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel Corp. today announced that it will produce processors for Fortinet Inc. firewalls... Intel will help Fortinet design and manufacture the successor to the SP5, which will aptly be called the SP6.

key_facts.fact: Fortinet is the first foundry customer Intel has publicly named under CEO Lip-Bu Tan, who took over the chipmaker in March 2025.
key_facts.excerpt: Fortinet is the first announced corporate customer for Intel's foundry under CEO Lip-Bu Tan, who took over the chipmaker in March 2025.

key_facts.fact: The Fortinet SP6 chip will be manufactured on the Intel 4 process, an EUV node Intel had so far reserved for its own products, making Fortinet the first named external customer for the node.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel to co-develop and manufacture Fortinet's next-gen firewall ASIC on Intel 4 — node gets its first named external customer... Intel 4, the EUV process the company has so far used only for its own products.

key_facts.fact: The SP6 is the custom silicon inside Fortinet's FortiGate firewalls, succeeding the current SP5 processor, and Intel will handle chip design, advanced packaging and manufacturing.
key_facts.excerpt: The two companies announced a strategic collaboration to build the Fortinet Security Processor 6, the custom silicon inside its FortiGate firewalls. Intel will handle the chip design, advanced packaging, and manufacturing.

key_facts.fact: The customer win landed two days before Intel's second-quarter earnings report, scheduled for Thursday, July 23.
key_facts.excerpt: Intel is scheduled to report second-quarter results on Thursday after the bell.
